label: Shaphan

text.BHSA 2CH 34:14: וּבְהֹוצִיאָ֣ם אֶת־הַכֶּ֔סֶף הַמּוּבָ֖א בֵּ֣ית יְהוָ֑ה מָצָא֙ חִלְקִיָּ֣הוּ הַכֹּהֵ֔ן אֶת־סֵ֥פֶר תֹּֽורַת־יְהוָ֖ה בְּיַד־מֹשֶֽׁה׃
text.KJV 2CH 34:14: And when they brought out the money that was brought into the house of the LORD, Hilkiah the priest found a book of the law of the LORD given by Moses.
text.BHSA 2CH 34:15: וַיַּ֣עַן חִלְקִיָּ֗הוּ וַיֹּ֨אמֶר֙ אֶל־שָׁפָ֣ן הַסֹּופֵ֔ר סֵ֧פֶר הַתֹּורָ֛ה מָצָ֖אתִי בְּבֵ֣ית יְהוָ֑ה וַיִּתֵּ֧ן חִלְקִיָּ֛הוּ אֶת־הַסֵּ֖פֶר אֶל־שָׁפָֽן׃
text.KJV 2CH 34:15: And Hilkiah answered and said to Shaphan the scribe, I have found the book of the law in the house of the LORD. And Hilkiah delivered the book to Shaphan.
text.BHSA 2CH 34:16: וַיָּבֵ֨א שָׁפָ֤ן אֶת־הַסֵּ֨פֶר֙ אֶל־הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ וַיָּ֨שֶׁב עֹ֧וד אֶת־הַמֶּ֛לֶךְ דָּבָ֖ר לֵאמֹ֑ר כֹּ֛ל אֲשֶׁר־נִתַּ֥ן בְּיַד־עֲבָדֶ֖יךָ הֵ֥ם עֹשִֽׂים׃
text.KJV 2CH 34:16: And Shaphan carried the book to the king, and brought the king word back again, saying, All that was committed to thy servants, they do it.

A.name: Shaphan
A.notes: He was sent to repair the house of the Lord (2CH 34:8)
family: scribe-of josiah (Josiah, prophesied son of the house of David (1KI 13:2), King of Jud)
grandfather-of gedaliah (Gedaliah, son of Ahikam, appointed King of Judah by Nebuchadnezzar (2K)

B.name: Shaphan
B.line: Secretary/scribe of King Josiah who read the found law-book to him.
family: companion-of hilkiah-2 (Hilkiah, the high priest of King Josiah's reign (2KI 22:4, 2CH 34:9))
scribe-of josiah (Josiah, prophesied son of the house of David (1KI 13:2), King of Jud)

why: The Hebrew identifies one Shaphan as הַסּוֹפֵר, “the scribe,” who receives Hilkiah’s law-book and carries it to the king. Both A and B fit these facts equally, so the text does not establish A rather than B or name two distinct people.
